meta.name: host-observer
meta.description: Use this when fulfilling claude-mem observer jobs on Grok Bot: reply only skip_summary or one full observation XML, never prose.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 执行Grok Bot的记忆观察任务,只输出标准总结或完整观测结果。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要让机器人按规范格式输出记忆观察结果。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a bot to report memory observations in a structured format.

howto.what: 在 claude-mem 的 Grok Bot observer 任务里,它不再写散文,只回 `<skip_summary />` 或一条完整 `<observation>` XML:真实标题、4–10 条带路径的事实和叙述。结果写入 outbox/{id}.txt。
howto.when: 当 Grok Bot 端派来 claude-mem observer 任务时接管:空闲、初始化或无工具结果时只回 skip_summary,完成一个可搜索单元时回一条 observation。
howto.what_en: In claude-mem observer jobs on Grok Bot it writes no prose, replying only with `<skip_summary />` or one `<observation>` XML: a real title, 4–10 facts with paths, and a narrative. Written to outbox/{id}.txt or the chat-completions body.
howto.when_en: Takes over when Grok Bot dispatches a claude-mem observer job: idle, init, or no tool results means reply `<skip_summary />` only; a finished searchable unit means one `<observation>`.

say_en.text: No tool results this time — reply only `<skip_summary reason="noise" />`
Write this as one `<observation>`: real title, 4–10 facts with paths, narrative
say_en.note: Never title with a tool name.

say_en.text: Save to outbox/{id}.txt, no prose, and skip /api/memory/save
